name: Muddle, the Ever-Changing
oracle_text: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Muddle becomes a copy of up to one target nonlegendary creature you control until end of turn, except it has myriad. (Whenever it attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, you may create a token copy that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control. Exile the tokens at end of combat.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Muddle becomes a copy of up to one target nonlegendary creature you control until end of turn, except it has myriad

needs.what: a `become_copy` `except_` key (707.9b) that adds an ability the copying card does NOT itself have -- e.g. `add_abilities: [i]` indexing the card's `grantable_abilities`, appended by `GameState.card_of` the way `copying_own_abilities` is -- so 'becomes a copy of X until end of turn, except it has myriad' writes the myriad triggered ability (as shipped in templates: a self-attacks trigger making tapped-and-attacking token copies exiled at end of combat) into the copiable values, where the myriad tokens and anything copying Muddle see it, and nothing happens when no target was chosen
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `except_` now takes `add_keywords` and `keep_abilities` (BECOME_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS). Myriad is not in `keywords` -- the pool writes it as a triggered ability -- so `add_keywords` cannot name it. `keep_abilities` only carries positions in the card's OWN printed `abilities` onto the copy; Muddle does not print myriad as its own ability, and writing it into `abilities` to keep it would give the uncopied Muddle myriad permanently. A `grant_ability` after the copy is a layer-6 grant, not a copiable value (the doc names it the near miss), so copies of Muddle would lack myriad. And the myriad trigger itself has a second gap: `copy_permanent` creates its token from the source's printed `def_id` and copy_overrides only, so a token copy of Muddle while it is copying another creature (an in-place `become_copy`, `obj.copying`) would be a copy of Muddle's own printed card rather than of the creature Muddle has become (707.2: the copiable values include the copy effect)
